sources.title: Government of the Commonwealth of the Bahamas

capital.evidence_quote: Nassau is the capital and primate commercial hub of the Commonwealth of the Bahamas

currency.evidence_quote: The Bahamian Dollar (BSD) is pegged 1:1 with the US Dollar; USD circulates freely

timezone.evidence_quote: The Bahamas observes Eastern Standard Time UTC-5 and daylight saving time UTC-4

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard nominal voltage delivered in the Bahamas is 120V alternating current at 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Transmission and domestic frequency is standardized at 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Electrical outlets in the Bahamas conform to North American Type A and grounded Type B plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 or 919 for emergency police assistance throughout the Bahamas

sources.title: Ministry of Health and Wellness of the Bahamas

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 911 or 919 for emergency ambulance dispatch in New Providence and Grand Bahama

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency fire response services across the islands

general.evidence_quote: 911 is the central emergency dispatcher for police, fire, and medical rescue

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police division patrols downtown Nassau, Bay Street, and Prince George Wharf cruise terminal

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Exuma, Eleuthera ve tatil adaları son derece güvenlidir; Nassau 'Over-the-Hill' bölgesinde dikkatli olunmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Family Islands like Exuma are very peaceful; exercise increased caution in downtown Nassau residential areas.
advisory_headline.de: Family Islands wie Exuma sind sehr friedlich; in Nassau (Over-the-Hill) erhöhte Vorsicht walten lassen.
advisory_headline.ru: Острова Эксума и семейные курорты спокойны; в Нассау (район Over-the-Hill) соблюдайте осторожность.
advisory_headline.es: Las islas periféricas como Exuma son muy pacíficas; ejerza mayor precaución en zonas residenciales de Nassau.

regional_warnings.reason: Gang violence and local crime in non-tourist residential neighborhoods; avoid after dark.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in the Bahamas measure approximately 52.1 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in the Bahamas reach 84.6 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: US Dollar is accepted 1:1 alongside the Bahamian Dollar everywhere. BTC (Bahamas Telecommunications Company) and Aliv provide 4G/LTE tourist eSIMs with coverage across New Providence and the Family Islands.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid tourist eSIM packages operate seamlessly across the Bahamian archipelago

tr.conditions: Türkiye Cumhuriyeti umuma mahsus, hususi ve hizmet pasaportu hamilleri 90 güne kadar vizeden muaftır.

us.conditions: US citizens can enter the Bahamas visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days (or up to 8 months with valid passport).

source.title: Ministry of Tourism of the Bahamas

de.conditions: German and EU citizens do not need a visa for tourist visits to the Bahamas of up to 90 days.

source.title: Ministry of Tourism of the Bahamas

gb.conditions: British passport holders can enter the Bahamas visa-free for up to 90 days (up to 21 days or longer depending on stamp).

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать на Багамские Острова без визы на срок до 90 дней с туристическими целями.

dos.title: Use US Dollars freely
dos.description: Bahamian Dollars and US Dollars are interchangeable at a 1:1 ratio everywhere in shops, restaurants, and tours.

dos.title: Explore the Family Islands (Out Islands)
dos.description: Take day trips to Exuma (swimming pigs) or Harbour Island (pink sand beaches) for the quintessential Bahamas experience.

dos.title: Agree on taxi fares before departure
dos.description: Many cabs do not use meters; establish the total fare with the driver before getting inside.

donts.title: Don't wander into Over-the-Hill areas at night
donts.description: Stay within well-lit resort corridors, Bay Street, and marina complexes; avoid walking alone through secluded residential areas.

donts.title: Don't touch stingrays or wild marine life aggressively
donts.description: Always follow ethical marine wildlife guidelines when visiting sandbars and stingray sanctuaries.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 15% is standard in restaurants and bars; always check whether a 15% service charge is already added to your bill.
